Summary:
Completed XSS and IDOR testing on OWASP Juice Shop at http://host.docker.internal:3100. Found and validated two main vulnerabilities: (1) CRITICAL - Unauthenticated product modification via PUT /api/Products/{id} allowing any user to modify product data without authentication, confirmed working with persistent changes to database; (2) MEDIUM - Reflected XSS in error pages via /api/search and /rest/search endpoints where q parameter reflects in HTML title tags. Tested 40+ endpoints across products, reviews, users, orders, and delivery endpoints. Most endpoints properly protected with 401 auth requirements. Documented all findings with working PoCs.

Findings:
- CRITICAL: Unauthenticated Product Modification - PUT /api/Products/{id} allows modification without auth, persists to database
- MEDIUM: Reflected XSS - Query parameter reflected in error page title tags on /api/search and /rest/search
- Verified public product catalog and reviews accessible without auth (expected)
- DELETE /api/Products properly requires 401 authentication
- User registration endpoint properly allows unauthenticated requests

Open items (unresolved, need follow-up):
- Stored XSS via reviews: POST endpoints return 500 errors, unable to fully test review submission
- DOM-based XSS in Angular: Fragment-based XSS detected but full exploitation requires browser environment
- User-level IDOR: /api/Users endpoint requires auth; unable to test cross-user access without valid tokens

Recommendations:
- File critical IDOR vulnerability report immediately for PUT /api/Products endpoint
- File medium XSS vulnerability report for error page reflection
- Implement authentication middleware on product modification endpoints
- HTML-escape all user input in error pages
- Set up root agent to coordinate any additional investigation
